preconditions.description: The number of strings k is between 1 and 2500.
The length of each string n is between 2 and 5000.
The total length of the strings does not exceed 5000.

postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' indicating no solution, or a string of length n.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(s[i] == c for s in strings) % 2 == 0 for i in range(n) for c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz')
postconditions.description: For each character position and each character, the count of occurrences across all strings is even.
